activity.role: Peruvian-born historian and author of Comentarios Reales
activity.notes: The first part of Comentarios Reales de los Incas was printed in Lisbon in 1609. Garcilaso had moved to Spain and wrote the work there; Lisbon was then in the Habsburg Iberian Union. This is a personal literary publication point, not a continuing Activity under the extinct Inca Empire. This Inca Garcilaso (1539–1616) is distinct from the Spanish Renaissance poet Garcilaso de la Vega (d.1536); the latter's NamuWiki article must not be linked.

sources.title: Fondo Antiguo — Biblioteca Nacional del Perú
sources.citation_text: The National Library of Peru catalogues the Inca Garcilaso de la Vega (1539–1616) and the first part of Comentarios Reales printed in Lisbon in 1609.

sources.title: Primera parte de los Comentarios reales — Biblioteca Nacional de España
sources.citation_text: The Spanish National Library identifies the author as Inca Garcilaso de la Vega and the first edition's Lisbon Pedro Crasbeeck imprint and 1609 date.

sources.title: Inca Garcilaso de la Vega — Memoria Chilena
sources.citation_text: Chilean National Library recounts the book written in Spain, the 1609 first part and the posthumous 1617 second part.
